output_list.criticism: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When minting tokens, the initialSupply is multiplied by 10^uint256(decimals), which can overflow if initialSupply is large enough.
The transfer function does not check if the balanceOf[_to] + _value overflows, causing a potential integer overflow.
The transferFrom function does not check if the balanceOf[_to] + _value overflows, causing a potential integer overflow.

The burn function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When burning tokens, the balanceOf[msg.sender] is decreased, and totalSupply is decreased, which can overflow if the balanceOf[msg.sender] is large enough.

The burnFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When burning tokens from an account, the balanceOf[_from] is decreased, and totalSupply is decreased, which can overflow if the balanceOf[_from] is large enough.
